purpose: Housing supply, demand, prices, rents, finance, policy, and distributional effects in defined markets.
editorial_principles: Use a named jurisdiction, population, and date where applicable.
Present comparisons on equal terms and label illustrative scenarios.
Verify primary sources and current guidance before production.
Define geography, tenure, quality, and time period; distinguish correlations from causal effects and avoid price forecasts.
